result.title: ODSS-Net: Orthogonally Decoupled Shared-Specific Representations for Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification
result.summary: Multi-modal object re-identification (ReID) leverages complementary information from heterogeneous sensors. Cross-modal alignment and fusion remain challenging. Existing methods mainly reduce modality gaps via feature alignment and fusion. However, alignment may entangle modality-shared structural information with modality-specific cues, while conventional fusion may not fully exploit complementary information. To address these issues, we propose ODSS-Net, a framework for orthogonally decoupled shared-specific representation learning and adaptive fusion of complementary modality-specific features. First, a Shared Structural Feature Construction (SSFC) module suppresses modality-dependent appearance variations and extracts modality-shared structural information. Then, an Orthogonal Specific Feature Learning (OSFL) module aggregates identity-relevant local information and removes the shared-aligned component via geometric orthogonal projection. Finally, a Sample Adaptive Mixture of Experts (SAMoE) module uses the shared structure as routing context to adaptively refine and fuse modality-specific features. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of ODSS-Net for multi-modal object ReID.

AI.brief_summary: ODSS-Net 面向多模态目标重识别，先构造模态共享的结构特征，再用几何正交投影剔除其中的共享对齐成分以得到模态特异特征，最后以共享结构作为路由上下文做样本自适应专家混合融合，在三个基准上验证有效性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「共享结构 / 特异线索」的正交解耦与以共享结构为路由上下文的融合方式，可能为 LVR 中区分任务必要视觉结构与模态外观扰动、缓解 latent 信息坍缩提供可核查的方法线索；属远任务迁移，尚需确认能否用于推理期内部状态。
